items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the GsonBuilder to fine-tune its auto-configuration before it creates a Gson instance.
items.translation: 希望自定义 GsonBuilder 以在创建 Gson 实例之前微调其自动配置的 Bean 可实现的回调接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
